items.title: Vídeo não mostra helicópteros dos EUA no Brasil durante eleições
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Um vídeo de supostos helicópteros dos Estados Unidos não tem relação com as eleições brasileiras que ocorrem neste domingo, ao contrário do que afirmam posts no Instagram. O registro está disponível na plataforma há mais de um mês e tem um rótulo indicando que as imagens foram criadas por IA.
items.body:
Um vídeo de supostos helicópteros dos Estados Unidos não tem relação com as eleições brasileiras que ocorrem neste domingo, ao contrário do que afirmam posts no Instagram. O registro está disponível na plataforma há mais de um mês e tem um rótulo indicando que as imagens foram criadas por IA.
Estes são os principais detalhes:
As imagens parecem ter sido feitas a partir de um veículo em movimento, enquanto helicópteros militares sobrevoam uma área descampada. “Estamos chegando, Brasil”, narra um homem ao fundo.
A mesma gravação circula no Instagram ao menos desde 19 de agosto de 2026, quando foi compartilhada com o aviso “Conteúdo de IA” e a localização “Estados Unidos da América”.
“Eu ‘tava’ na estrada por aqui quando comecei a ver essa movimentação e pensei: ‘Rapaz… o Brasil vai receber visita!’”, diz a legenda da postagem , publicada no perfil de um brasileiro que diz morar nos EUA.
O autor do post respondeu a um comentário que apontou o uso de IA que “você não sabe brincar, não, olha a legenda”.
Até o momento, não há registros de que o governo dos EUA tenha enviado helicópteros ao Brasil em meio às eleições.
Uma possível interferência dos EUA no pleito preocupa autoridades brasileiras e é alvo de uma investigação da Polícia Federal (PF).
Veredicto: falso. O vídeo de supostos helicópteros dos EUA no Brasil nas vésperas das eleições circula desde agosto com um rótulo de IA.
Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

items.title: AkzoNobel to sell unit to Nippon Paint for over $1 billion, FT reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Dulux paint maker AkzoNobel is nearing a deal to sell its Southeast Asian decorative paints business to Nippon Paint for well over $1 billion, the Financial Times reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with the matter.
items.body:
Dulux paint maker AkzoNobel (AKZO.AS) is nearing a deal to sell its Southeast Asian decorative paints business to Nippon Paint (4612.T) for well over $1 billion, the Financial Times reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with the matter.
The Dutch company could reach an agreement as early as Monday, the newspaper said. The divestment would include decorative paint operations in Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and Singapore, as well as Papua New Guinea and Australia.
Reuters could not immediately verify the FT report. AkzoNobel and Nippon Paint did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment.
Nippon Paint submitted [USN:L6N43F003 TEXT:"multiple proposals"] to acquire AkzoNobel's decorative paints business, AkzoNobel said in July, valuing it at about €7.5 billion ($8.44 billion). That approach followed the [USN:L6N42B0EM TEXT:"withdrawal"] of a €12.5 billion bid for the entire company that Nippon Paint had pursued jointly with US-based paintmaker Sherwin-Williams (SHW.N) in June.
The FT report added that Nippon remains interested in a larger deal for the decorative paint business, but that integration of the Southeast Asia business could occupy the company for some time and that AkzoNobel does not have plans to sell further assets from the business.
($1 = 0.8887 euros)

items.title: ¿Se puede descarbonizar la aviación sin encarecer los tiquetes? El reto pendiente de Latinoamérica
items.author: Carlos Cuevas
items.summary: Aunque la región tiene el potencial de producir hasta 40% del SAF que consumirá el mundo, deberá hacerlo sin trasladar los costos a los pasajeros. Esto dicen los expertos.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — Aunque Latinoamérica puede llegar a producir el 40% del combustible sostenible de aviación (SAF, en inglés) que va a consumir el mundo, necesita una estrategia para avanzar en este tema sin que el costo de desarrollarlo e implementarlo se traslade a los pasajeros. Esa fue una de las conclusiones a las que llegó un grupo de expertos sobre la descarbonización del transporte aéreo, en el contexto de la asamblea general anual 2026 del Consejo Mundial de Aeropuertos (ACI) realizada en Lima, Perú, a la que asistió Bloomberg Línea . Ver más: Latinoamérica necesitará US$178.000 millones para sus aeropuertos y más desregulación para crecer: ACI-LAC Paula Darocca, vicepresidenta de crecimiento de negocios de Airbus para América Latina y el Caribe, dijo que la reducción de gases de efecto invernadero (GEI) en el sector aéreo debería partir de dos fases: una de transición hacia aviones más ecológicos y mejoras operacionales en los aeropuertos y otra de preparación para nuevas fuentes de energía, como el combustible SAF. “Hoy, los aviones de Airbus consumen un 25% menos de combustible que los de las últimas generaciones. Pero debe haber progresos operacionales, como establecer más rutas aéreas directas para evitar no solo el consumo de combustible, sino las emisiones GEI”, comentó Darocca. En la medida en que se avance en esta materia, vendrá el siguiente paso: apostar de manera progresiva como el SAF. “En Latinoamérica y el Caribe se consume aproximadamente el 5% del combustible Jet A1 de avión del mundo y la región tiene la capacidad de ser productor del 30 o 40% del SAF que va a consumir el mundo”, expuso Darocca. “Lo importante es q u e las economías locales no se emocionen con esta idea imponiendo SAF para las sublíneas locales y desarrollar esos mercados, si luego se van a cortar”. La expresión “cortar” implica que, eventualmente, el costo de preparar la producción e implementación del SAF se traslade a los viajeros, desincentivando el uso del transporte aéreo, que es bajo en comparación con otras regiones. Mientras que en España el número de pasajeros per cápita es de 6,51 y en Estados Unidos de 5,69, en mercados regionales como el de Brasil es de solo 1,1, de acuerdo con las cifras de la oficina Consejo Mundial de Aeropuertos para América Latina y el Caribe (ACI-LAC). En ese contexto, Daroca agregó que es muy importante una comunicación entre regulador, productor y consumidor del SAF para que el bolsillo de los viajeros no se vea impactado. “Que el SAF esté disponible, pero sin que lo tenga que pagar el pasajero, porque lo veremos después: va a pasar que no haya pasajero, no haya avión, no haya aerolínea, no haya esfuerzo. Nada”. Ángela María Orozco, vicepresidenta senior de asuntos corporativos de Avianca ( PFAVH ) y exministra de Transporte de Colombia, subrayó que ahora mismo el reto de descarbonizar el sector aéreo es cómo lograrlo sin que incremente el costo de los combustibles y, por ende, el precio de los tiquetes adquiridos por los viajeros, como podría suceder con el SAF si no hay una estrategia clara. “Cuando uno, desde una aerolínea, ve que más o menos el combustible llega a representar casi el 40% de sus costos operacionales, lo primero que debe entender es que tiene que optimizar la operación y eficiencia”, dijo Orozco. Orozco sostuvo que, por ejemplo, el exceso de capacidad de operaciones del Aeropuerto Internacional El Dorado en Bogotá está generando un consumo mayor de combustible en los aviones. “Cuando un aeropuerto excede su capacidad, que es el caso de El Dorado, siempre estamos teniendo demoras derivadas de las esperas antes de aterrizar, de no poder aterrizar cuando hay mal tiempo o de retrasos en las pistas”, detalló Orozco. “Todo eso es combustible que se está quemando. Y la manera más sana de reducir emisiones es simplemente el combustible que no se consume”. Humberto Suárez, coordinador de las Unidades de Negocios de los Aeropuertos y Servicios Auxiliares (ASA), un organismo descentralizado del Gobierno de México, relató que en el país se ha estado avanzando en una hoja de ruta para la producción y uso del SAF. ASA, con la Agencia Federal de Aviación Civil Mexicana, está llevando a cabo un proceso de coordinación interinstitucional con diferentes secretarías de Gobierno, incluyendo la de Ambiente y la de Economía, para tener una “trazabilidad clara” sobre el tema en 2030, que pueda ser ejecutada hasta 2050. “Eso ya nos empieza a abrir un poco el panorama para brindar certeza jurídica, que es lo que piden las aerolíneas, para determinar el uso de algún combustible específico, como el SAF. Internamente, ya tenemos clara una hoja de ruta, que pensamos publicar a finales de este año o, probablemente, el siguiente año”, ahondó Suárez. ASA actualmente está desarrollando un programa piloto para adaptar la infraestructura que ya tiene para el blending o mezcla de hidrocarburos refinados —con una planta ya certificada—, con combustibles sostenibles. Incluso está aprendiendo de Brasil el uso de la “explotación de la caña de azúcar” como biocombustible. Partiendo de esa base, según Suárez, “México tiene dos grandes retos, el pit stop , toda la tecnología que podemos aplicar con las materias primas y, por otro lado, independientemente del costo, la regulación que vamos a tener”. Ver más: Dos aeropuertos de Venezuela podrían atraer inversión privada, pero falta seguridad jurídica: ACI-LAC

items.title: Manchester City beat hapless Arsenal 4-2 to stay top of WSL
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Lauren Hemp scored twice as Manchester City came from behind on two occasions to beat Arsenal 4-2 in the Women's Super League on Sunday, keeping the champions top of the table heading into the international break after a fifth straight win from their opening five matches.
items.body:
Lauren Hemp scored twice as Manchester City came from behind on two occasions to beat Arsenal 4-2 in the Women's Super League on Sunday, keeping the champions top of the table heading into the international break after a fifth straight win from their opening five matches.
Arsenal went ahead through Lisa Baum in the 43rd minute, but City levelled when Hemp forced the ball home from a tight angle in first-half stoppage time.
Alessia Russo put the Gunners back in front four minutes after the break but again City came back, Kerstin Casparij equalising in the 63rd minute before Hemp put them in front for the first time nine minutes later.
Striker Bunny Shaw sealed the three points in the 84th minute with her fifth goal of the season to condemn Arsenal, who are without a win since the opening day of the season, to their second straight defeat after losing 1-0 away to Chelsea last week.
The loss leaves Arsenal in 10th spot on five points from five games after a dismal start to the campaign.
Earlier in the afternoon, Sonia Bompastor's Chelsea thumped West Ham United 3-0 to put them into second place, two points behind City. They took the lead thanks to a Melvine Malard strike and added two late goals through Keira Walsh and Maika Hamano.
London City Lionesses showed that they will be a force to be reckoned with in the title race, Alexia Putellas scoring twice in the first half of a 6-1 thrashing of Tottenham Hotspur, who were left shell-shocked by the pressing of the visitors.
Spurs had only conceded two goals in the first four outings, but they were hit for six as London City notched their third successive win in impressive fashion to move to third place on 12 points.
Charlton Athletic, who are still searching for their first point since being promoted, remain bottom of the 14-team table after a 5-1 hammering at the hands of Brighton & Hove Albion, with Kiko Seike scoring twice for the Seagulls.
Everton's strong start to the season continued with a 2-1 win over Birmingham City that lifts them to fifth spot in the table on nine points, two ahead of cross-town rivals Liverpool, who lost 1-0 to Manchester United on Saturday.

items.body: Bankers in Hong Kong skipped the summer break as an AIfueled rush for capital sent share sales to a record, defying abruising selloff in the city’s stocks. Initial public offerings, placements and block trades raised $47.5 billion in JulySeptember, the biggest haul ever for the period, according todata compiled by Bloomberg. That pushed fundraising this year above $92 billion and within reach of the $112.5 billion record set in 2021, though the recent surge in bond yields and poor deal performance are making investors and issuers more cautious. AI has been at the heart of Hong Kong’s deal revival, but this summer brought a new level of intensity.

items.title: South Africa's Nortje eyes test return against Australia after lengthy absence
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: South Africa fast bowler Anrich Nortje could make a remarkable return to first-class cricket after an absence of almost four years to help an injury-hampered South Africa attack in the first test against Australia, which starts in Durban on Friday.
items.body:
South Africa fast bowler Anrich Nortje could make a remarkable return to first-class cricket after an absence of almost four years to help an injury-hampered South Africa attack in the first test against Australia, which starts in Durban on Friday.
With fitness doubts over pace spearhead Kagiso Rabada and three other bowlers ruled out with hamstring injuries, Nortje is set to return to red-ball cricket for the first time since South Africa's test victory over West Indies in March 2023.
That match, in which he took 5-36 in the first innings, was Nortje's last first-class appearance.
A succession of injury setbacks, as he struggled with back and hip problems, subsequently led him to focus on the shorter formats, where bowling in brief spells has helped reduce the strain on his body.
The 32-year-old has evolved into a T20 specialist, but said on Sunday he had been working on his red-ball skills.
"It's been quite a bit of a focus for me to try and execute skills with the red ball, to build loads gradually and in the right way try and get the overs up,” he told reporters on Sunday.
“It's something that I've been doing for quite some time. There's been quite some effort put in to try and upskill again, and improve from where I left off.
"I'll be very excited if I can put my test cap on again. Growing up, it's the format you want to play. It's the motivation when you train," he added.
Nortje has featured in 19 tests with a bowling average of 26.71 and regularly bowled at speeds in excess of 145kph – with his action taking a heavy toll on his body.
TEST CRICKET BRINGS OUT EXTRA FIRE "You don't think of the tough times in T20 cricket. You just think about executing skills there, whereas in tests, you think about the tough times, the good times, the hard work and think that gets you through some sessions.
"There's just that little bit of extra X-factor that comes out, or fire that comes out, and energy that comes out," Nortje added. "Guys want to do well, and everyone wants to perform. It is a big series."
South Africa started an intra-squad match on Sunday and late Monday will cut their preliminary squad from 18 to 15, with Nortje expected to make the cut despite his lengthy absence.
"The guys have grown quite a bit,” he said of the test side which has since gone on to win the World Test Championship, beating Australia in mid-2025.
“They've played a lot and they've done really well. Hopefully, I can just add on to that. I'm very keen to get going and be on the park and try to do well for the country," Nortje added.

The 32-year-old has evolved into a T20 specialist, but said on Sunday he had been working on his red-ball skills.
"It's been quite a bit of a focus for me to try and execute skills with the red ball, to build loads gradually and in the right way try and get the overs up,” he told reporters on Sunday.
“It's something that I've been doing for quite some time. There's been quite some effort put in to try and upskill again, and improve from where I left off. 
"I'll be very excited if I can put my test cap on again. Growing up, it's the format you want to play. It's the motivation when you train," he added.
Nortje has featured in 19 tests with a bowling average of 26.71 and regularly bowled at speeds in excess of 145kph – with his action taking a heavy toll on his body.
TEST CRICKET BRINGS OUT EXTRA FIRE
"You don't think of the tough times in T20 cricket. You just think about executing skills there, whereas in tests, you think about the tough times, the good times, the hard work and think that gets you through some sessions.
"There's just that little bit of extra X-factor that comes out, or fire that comes out, and energy that comes out," Nortje added. "Guys want to do well, and everyone wants to perform. It is a big series."
South Africa started an intra-squad match on Sunday and late Monday will cut their preliminary squad from 18 to 15, with Nortje expected to make the cut despite his lengthy absence.
"The guys have grown quite a bit,” he said of the test side which has since gone on to win the World Test Championship, beating Australia in mid-2025.
“They've played a lot and they've done really well. Hopefully, I can just add on to that. I'm very keen to get going and be on the park and try to do well for the country," Nortje added.

items.title: Valkyries' Janelle Salaun unanimous choice as Sixth Player of Year
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Golden State Valkyries forward Janelle Salaun was unanimously selected as the 2026 WNBA Sixth Player of the Year, the league announced Sunday.
items.body:
Golden State Valkyries forward Janelle Salaun was unanimously selected as the 2026 WNBA Sixth Player of the Year, the league announced Sunday.
Salaun earned the honor for the first time after receiving all 74 votes from a national panel of sportswriters and broadcasters. A player had to play more games as a reserve than as a starter to be eligible for the award.
Salaun, 25, led all WNBA reserves in scoring with 12.7 points per game. The 6-foot-2 France native came off the bench in all 40 of the games in which she played, setting league single-season records for points (509) and 3-pointers made (93) by a reserve.
Naz Hillmon of the Atlanta Dream won the award last year.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley out vs. Rams with hamstring injury
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Philadelphia Eagles running back Saquon Barkley was ruled out of Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams after he sustained a hamstring injury on his second carry.
items.body:
Philadelphia Eagles running back Saquon Barkley was ruled out of Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams after he sustained a hamstring injury on his second carry.
Barkley was limping on the sideline at the end of a 6-yard run with 11:34 left in the first quarter. Replays showed him rubbing the back of his right leg before going to the medical tent.
He was replaced by Tank Bigsby before heading to the locker room. The team initially said he was questionable to return.
Barkley, 29, has rushed for 182 yards and no touchdowns in four games this season, including 8 yards on his two carries Sunday.
In his previous three games against the Rams since joining Philadelphia, Barkley rushed for 506 yards and four touchdowns on 70 carries. That included a franchise-record 255-yard game on Nov. 24, 2024 and a team playoff-record 205 yards in a divisional round game on Jan. 19, 2025.
The Philadelphia offense already was playing without top wide receiver DeVonta Smith (hamstring), tight end Dallas Goedert (knee) and right tackle Lane Johnson (personal).
--Field Level Media

items.title: Colorado State DC out after mid-game demotion
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The in-game decision by Colorado State head coach Jim Mora on Saturday to change defensive play-callers led to the dismissal of the Rams' defensive coordinator.
items.body:
The in-game decision by Colorado State head coach Jim Mora on Saturday to change defensive play-callers led to the dismissal of the Rams' defensive coordinator.
As he watched Oregon State pile up the yards in an eventual 56-26 loss, Mora told defensive coordinator Tyson Summers that he was done calling plays for the day. Mora transferred the duties to associate head coach and defensive line coach Kenny McClendon.
When Summers departed the field after his demotion, that ended his tenure at Colorado State.
"Tyson was relieved of his play-calling duties. He left the field, and he is no longer with this football program," Mora said postgame. "That is permanent."
The change occurred in the first half, per local reports. At halftime, the Beavers had a 35-14 lead. Oregon State finished with 650 yards of total offense -- 223 on the ground and 427 via air as Beavers quarterback Braden Atkinson finished the game 31-of-34 passing with five touchdowns.
Summers, 46, has an extensive coaching background, beginning in the college ranks at his alma mater - Presbyterian - in 2003. He got his first chance as a defensive coordinator at UCF (2012-14), followed by a season as DC and safeties coach at Colorado State, departing for a two-year stint as head coach at Georgia Southern.
Summers also spent two seasons as the DC at Colorado (2019-20), then three at Western Kentucky in the same role (2022-24) before returning to Colorado State in 2025 as DC under Jay Norvell.
When Norvell was fired seven games into last season, Summers took over as interim coach, and the Rams finished with an 0-5 record.
Colorado State (2-3), which has not finished above .500 since 2017, snatched Mora last fall from UConn, where he rebuilt the struggling program in four seasons. Previously the head coach at UCLA and in the NFL with the Atlanta Falcons and Seattle Seahawks, Mora kept Summers on board.
Mora, 64, said McClendon will be the defensive coordinator for the rest of the season.
"He was put in a very difficult situation, and he responded well, the players responded well," Mora said. "Very first play he called as a defensive coordinator in his entire life was a sack, caused a fumble. So we're going to get better, we're going to get a lot better. He's a good football coach."
Colorado State defeated Wyoming and Southern Utah to start the season, allowing 37 total points. Since then, in losses to BYU, UTSA and Oregon State, the Rams have surrendered 156 points -- an average of 52 per game.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Nunes Marques diz esperar judicialização das eleições, mas afirma que pleito transcorre normalmente
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O presidente do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE), Kassio Nunes Marques, afirmou neste domingo ser esperado que candidatos acionem a Justiça com questionamentos relacionados às eleições, mas ponderou que a votação está transcorrendo com normalidade e transparência, também sem indícios de interferência internacional.
items.body:
O presidente do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE), Kassio Nunes Marques, afirmou neste domingo ser esperado que candidatos acionem a Justiça com questionamentos relacionados às eleições, mas ponderou que a votação está transcorrendo com normalidade e transparência, também sem indícios de interferência internacional.
Em entrevista coletiva por volta das 14h com dados preliminares sobre a eleição, Nunes Marques afirmou que as urnas estão funcionando normalmente e não houve necessidade de uso de votação manual em nenhum ponto do país.
“Há uma tradição na justiça brasileira de judicialização, então seria de se esperar que os candidatos, não só à Presidência da República, mas deputados estaduais e federais e governadores batam às portas da Justiça com os seus questionamentos”, disse, citando como exemplos ações sobre abuso de poder político e econômico de candidatos.
“Estamos bastante confiantes de que até agora não temos ainda do que se queixar", disse Nunes Marques. "Tudo tem funcionado na maior normalidade e com a maior transparência possível.”
De acordo com o presidente do TSE, 1.121 urnas com algum tipo de falha foram substituídas, 0,2% do total.
Em relação a irregularidades, Nunes Marques afirmou que 59 pessoas foram conduzidas pela polícia por suspeita de crime eleitoral e mais de R$380 mil em espécie foram apreendidos.
Ele enfatizou que o TSE não identificou nenhum indicativo de interferência estrangeira nas eleições.
“Equipes que monitoram riscos internacionais não apontam qualquer tipo de risco”, afirmou.
O diretor-geral da Polícia Federal, Andrei Rodrigues, afirmou mais cedo neste domingo que a corporação abriu [USN:L1N45Q03S TEXT:"investigação"] para apurar suposto esquema de financiamento de uma agenda de extrema-direita no Brasil pelo governo norte-americano de Donald Trump que teria entre os objetivos interferir nas eleições brasileiras. A investigação foi solicitada pela Advocacia-Geral da União (AGU).

items.title: Australia investiga los vínculos del copiloto de flydubai con el país, dice la policía
items.author: Praveen Menon, Alexander Cornwell
items.creator: Praveen Menon, Alexander Cornwell
items.summary: Una unidad antiterrorista australiana en la que participan varios organismos está investigando los vínculos con Australia del copiloto del vuelo FZ1073 de flydubai, quien apuñaló a su capitán y luego intentó secuestrar el avión, informó el domingo un portavoz de la policía.
items.body:
Una unidad antiterrorista australiana en la que participan varios organismos está investigando los vínculos con Australia del copiloto del vuelo FZ1073 de flydubai, quien apuñaló a su capitán y luego intentó secuestrar el avión, informó el domingo un portavoz de la policía.
El Equipo Conjunto Antiterrorista de Victoria, integrado por la policía federal, la policía estatal de Victoria y la agencia de inteligencia ASIO, estaba "investigando los vínculos de este hombre con Australia", dijo el portavoz de la Policía Federal Australiana.
Dos fuentes al tanto de la investigación indicaron que el copiloto estudió en una universidad de Melbourne, la capital del estado australiano de Victoria. Una tercera fuente señaló que estudió en la Universidad RMIT hace aproximadamente una década. La RMIT declinó hacer comentarios.
El copiloto del vuelo FZ1073 de flydubai, que el miércoles se dirigía a Israel desde Dubái, atacó al piloto con un hacha de emergencia, según dijo el sábado el fiscal general de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos, que calificó el incidente de "ataque terrorista".
El vuelo FZ1073 debió de parecer una "montaña rusa vertical", ya que descendió 16.000 pies en unos 30 segundos antes de estabilizarse y aterrizar sin incidentes, según un instructor de aviación que recreó el descenso en un simulador de vuelo para Reuters.
COPILOTO DETENIDO EN LOS EAU Dos fuentes han afirmado que el copiloto es un ciudadano omaní llamado Hamam Al-Hamami. Las autoridades israelíes no han revelado el nombre del copiloto, pero han indicado que es de Omán. Las autoridades de los EAU y flydubai no han hecho pública la identidad del copiloto.
Reuters no ha podido contactar de forma independiente con Al-Hamami, que se encuentra bajo custodia en los Emiratos Árabes Unidos, para recabar sus comentarios. Los Emiratos Árabes Unidos no han anunciado ningún cargo formal contra él y se desconoce si ha designado a un abogado. Omán no se ha pronunciado sobre el incidente.
Se evitó una catástrofe a bordo del vuelo FZ1073 después de que los pasajeros y la tripulación redujeran al copiloto, quien había atacado al capitán en lo que, según las autoridades israelíes, fue un intento de estrellar el avión, que transportaba a más de 170 pasajeros y tripulantes. El fiscal general de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos ha declarado que el copiloto había intentado tomar el control del avión.
La mayoría de los pasajeros a bordo eran ciudadanos israelíes.
Un piloto de reserva de flydubai que viajaba en ese vuelo tomó el control de la aeronave y la hizo aterrizar en el aeropuerto de Tabuk, en el noroeste de Arabia Saudita, donde el copiloto fue detenido por las autoridades sauditas y posteriormente trasladado a los Emiratos Árabes Unidos el jueves.
El Financial Times informó el domingo de que Al-Hamami habría visitado lo que describió como mezquitas radicales y páginas web extremistas durante su estancia en Australia, citando a dos personas familiarizadas con la investigación. Según el Financial Times, los servicios de inteligencia australianos tenían un expediente sobre esta persona.
Reuters no pudo verificar de inmediato la información del FT. El Gobierno de Australia no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios fuera del horario laboral habitual.
El primer ministro israelí, Benjamin Netanyahu, dijo que el copiloto había sido sometido a un adoctrinamiento islamista radical y que tenía claras intenciones suicidas, aunque no ha precisado cuándo ni dónde se produjo supuestamente dicho adoctrinamiento.
El domingo ordenó al Consejo de Seguridad Nacional que nombrara a un investigador para "llevar a cabo una revisión exhaustiva de todos los aspectos de seguridad relacionados con la aviación civil extranjera con destino a Israel".
Israel no mantiene relaciones diplomáticas oficiales con Omán, y Netanyahu también ha afirmado que no se permite a pilotos de esos países operar vuelos con destino a Israel. No está claro cómo llegó a ser asignado el copiloto al vuelo con destino a Tel Aviv.

items.title: Merz anuncia nuevas ayudas militares en Kiev y dice que Alemania no se dejará intimidar
items.author: Andreas Rinke, Felix Hoske
items.creator: Andreas Rinke, Felix Hoske
items.summary: Alemania no se dejará intimidar para que retire su apoyo a Ucrania, dijo el domingo el canciller Friedrich Merz, al anunciar una nueva ayuda militar de 1.000 millones de euros (1.100 millones de dólares) durante una visita a Kiev marcada por los ataques con drones rusos.
items.body:
Alemania no se dejará intimidar para que retire su apoyo a Ucrania, dijo el domingo el canciller Friedrich Merz, al anunciar una nueva ayuda militar de 1.000 millones de euros (1.100 millones de dólares) durante una visita a Kiev marcada por los ataques con drones rusos.
Las sirenas antiaéreas y las explosiones resonaron repetidamente en toda la capital ucraniana mientras Merz y el presidente ucraniano, Volodímir Zelenski, visitaban un monumento en memoria de los soldados fallecidos durante la guerra, que ya dura cuatro años, así como la Academia de Ciencias, donde al menos dos personas murieron en un ataque con drones la semana pasada.
Rusia ha intensificado sus ataques con drones contra Kiev y otras ciudades en las últimas semanas, apuntando a infraestructuras de telecomunicaciones, electricidad y transporte, así como contra instalaciones militares.
En una rueda de prensa junto a Zelenski, Merz dijo que Moscú estaba intentando minar la confianza del pueblo ucraniano y anunció una ayuda de 350 millones de euros para las reparaciones en el sector energético. Afirmó que Alemania seguía siendo el principal aliado de Ucrania.
"Hacemos esto no solo para proteger la integridad territorial de Ucrania; lo hacemos en nuestro propio interés, ya que es una cuestión de seguridad para Europa", dijo Merz, señalando que Rusia estaba llevando a cabo ciberataques y campañas de desinformación que atentaban contra el orden democrático europeo.
"Esto demuestra que no nos dejaremos intimidar", añadió.
Rusia ha afirmado que las acusaciones de guerra híbrida carecen de fundamento y son fruto de la histeria antirrusa.
Las autoridades indicaron que los directivos de las empresas alemanas, que viajaron con Merz, habían firmado 16 acuerdos con el Gobierno y empresas ucranianas por un valor aproximado de 6.500 millones de euros.
Entre esos acuerdos, Ucrania firmó un contrato con la firma alemana Diehl Defence para el suministro de misiles de defensa aérea IRIS-T, así como un acuerdo para equipos de radar con Hensoldt y para drones interceptores a reacción con Quantum Systems.
Zelenski elogió un nuevo dron interceptor a reacción, denominado SPYS y desarrollado por Quantum, por mostrar resultados prometedores. Dijo que Ucrania y Alemania estaban a punto de cerrar un amplio acuerdo de defensa que, según había declarado anteriormente, incluiría la producción de drones, misiles y software relacionado.
ZELENSKI SE COMPROMETE A RESPONDER Desde el verano boreal, Rusia ha atacado a diario infraestructuras civiles y militares con decenas de drones de ataque a reacción de alta velocidad, que Ucrania ha tenido dificultades para derribar debido a que son mucho más rápidos que las versiones anteriores con hélice.
Uno de los ataques rusos del domingo alcanzó el Puente del Norte, que cruza el río Dniéper, dañando su calzada, según informó el alcalde de Kiev, Vitali Klitschko, a través de Telegram. La explosión dejó dos heridos y dañó un sistema de suministro de agua caliente de la zona, añadió.
Zelenski dijo que la decisión de Rusia de intensificar los ataques aéreos contra objetivos de infraestructura se debía a los reveses que había sufrido en el campo de batalla, y prometió que Ucrania tomaría represalias. Aseguró que el presidente ruso, Vladimir Putin, quería obligar a los residentes a huir de las principales ciudades de Ucrania.
"Si nuestros puentes se derrumban, conseguiremos salir de esta situación, pero su pueblo también lo notará… Se trata de la máxima escalada de esta guerra", dijo Zelenski a los periodistas.
Rusia lleva desde la semana pasada atacando los puentes de Kiev con el objetivo de cortar las conexiones entre las dos partes de la capital y las rutas logísticas entre el centro y el este de Ucrania.
MERZ PIDE FIN DE UNA "GUERRA SIN SENTIDO" Zelenski dijo que el enviado estadounidense, Steve Witkoff, le había mandado un mensaje para instarle a reanudar las conversaciones trilaterales lo antes posible. Señaló que Ucrania estaba dispuesta a reunirse este mes y esperaba que Rusia se sumara, pero añadió que los aliados occidentales deben ejercer más presión sobre Moscú para poner fin a la guerra.
Más temprano en el día, durante la visita a la Academia de Ciencias, gravemente dañada, Merz hizo un llamamiento a Putin para que "ponga fin a esta guerra sin sentido".
"Estamos preparados para conversaciones, estamos preparados para debatir cómo poner fin a esta guerra, pero estos ataques bárbaros frente la población civil de Ucrania deben cesar", dijo el líder alemán.
El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de Rusia dijo el sábado que Moscú seguiría atacando sistemáticamente objetivos en Ucrania en lo que calificó de ataques de represalia por los ataques ucranianos contra Rusia. Advirtió a los ciudadanos extranjeros y al personal diplomático que no viajaran a Ucrania.
(1 dólar = 0,8887 euros)

items.title: Eagles RT Lane Johnson inactive vs. Rams
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Philadelphia Eagles All-Pro right tackle Lane Johnson was listed as inactive for Sunday's game against the visiting Los Angeles Rams.
items.body:
Philadelphia Eagles All-Pro right tackle Lane Johnson was listed as inactive for Sunday's game against the visiting Los Angeles Rams.
Johnson was given a game designation as questionable earlier Sunday due to personal reasons before the Eagles ruled him out 90 minutes prior to kickoff.
Philadelphia (2-1) is without six starters in all: Johnson, wide receiver DeVonta Smith, tight end Dallas Goedert, left guard Landon Dickerson, linebacker Zack Baun and safety Marcus Epps. Wideout Hollywood Brown, offensive tackle Fred Johnson and quarterback Cole Payton also were listed as inactive.
Rookie tackle Markel Bell started in place of Johnson.
Johnson, who turned 36 in May, told reporters in the summer that the 2026 season probably would be his last, citing priorities and his parents' health among his reasons.
The two-time first-team All-Pro reportedly was mulling retirement following a 2025 campaign that saw him sit out the final seven games of the regular season and the team's NFC wild-card loss to the San Francisco 49ers due to a Lisfranc injury.
Johnson is a two-time Super Bowl champion and six-time Pro Bowl selection. He has started all three games this season and 171 in his career since Philadelphia drafted him with the No. 4 overall pick in 2013.
As for the Rams (1-2), star defensive end Aaron Donald joined tight end Colby Parkinson, cornerbacks Cam Lampkin and Jaylen Watson, offensive lineman Bill Murray, wide receiver C.J. Daniels and quarterback Ty Simpson (emergency third QB) as inactive for the contest.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Britain's Green Party votes to class Zionism as a form of racism - Reuters
items.summary: Britain's Green Party votes to class Zionism as a form of racism    Reuters
items.raw_description: Britain's Green Party votes to class Zionism as a form of racism    Reuters

items.title: Britain's Green Party votes to class Zionism as a form of racism
items.author: David Milliken
items.creator: David Milliken
items.summary: Britain's Green Party voted on Sunday to class Zionism as a form of racism, drawing criticism from British Jews and from the Israeli government which said it now viewed the party as "a body that gives legitimacy to terrorism".
items.body:
Britain's Green Party voted on Sunday to class Zionism as a form of racism, drawing criticism from British Jews and from the Israeli government which said it now viewed the party as "a body that gives legitimacy to terrorism".
The party – which received 6% of the vote in national elections in 2024 – said it regarded Zionism as "an ethnonationalist political project" and repeated its call for Britain's Labour government to end all arms trade with Israel.
"The motion also restates the Green Party's backing for the right to self-determination and calls for the establishment of a single democratic state throughout historic Palestine," the party said in a statement.
The definition of Zionism – which inspired the foundation of the modern state of Israel in the 20th century – and what it implies for the rights of non-Jews in Israel and neighbouring territory, is contentious. Jewish groups sometimes define it as a right to Jewish self-determination.
The Green Party motion passed by a majority of 1,022 to 813 despite opposition from many senior figures. Party leader Zack Polanski, who is seeking election to Parliament on Thursday in former Prime Minister Keir Starmer's now-vacant London constituency, did not vote.
The result was condemned by British Jewish groups.
"The Green Party has made antisemitism party policy and become a racist party," the Movement for Progressive Judaism said, adding that the support of some Jews for the motion did not mean it would not be used to discriminate against others.
Israeli foreign minister Gideon Sa’ar has decided to declare Polanski barred from entering Israel, the foreign ministry said in a post on X Sunday.
It said the Green Party motion "constitutes a clear antisemitic text according to the IHRA (International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance) definition, as it denies the Jewish people’s right to self-determination," the ministry said.
Mothin Ali, deputy leader of the Green Party and a supporter of the motion, told Sky News on Saturday that the heavy Palestinian death toll in Israel's conflict with Hamas – which followed the Palestinian militant group's deadly 2023 attack on an Israeli music festival – was the key context for the vote.
"The motion defines Zionism quite clearly. It defines it as an ethnonationalist movement. It defines it as ethnic cleansing. It defines it as genocide," Ali said.
Britain's government views Israeli settlers' actions in the West Bank as [USN:L8N45007X TEXT:"amounting to ethnic cleansing"] but has said courts must decide if other Israeli actions qualify as genocide.
Israel – which rejects claims of ethnic cleansing and genocide – called on Sunday for other British political parties to condemn the Green Party vote. "The Greens have adopted not only the green of Hamas, but also its ideology: the elimination of the State of Israel through armed struggle," it said.
Polanski and other senior Green Party figures said they would "continue to call out the heinous crimes of the Netanyahu government," and that "there is no conflict between supporting the rights of Palestinians and the rights of Jewish people."

items.title: Iran's oil minister resigns for personal reasons, state media reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Iran's Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad has resigned for personal reasons, and Hamid Bovard, chief executive of the government-owned National Iranian Oil Company, will be acting minister, state media said on Sunday.
items.body:
Iran's Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad has resigned for personal reasons, and Hamid Bovard, chief executive of the government-owned National Iranian Oil Company, will be acting minister, state media said on Sunday.
Mohsen Paknejad, oil minister of the OPEC member country since August 2024, resigned as the seven-month-old war between Iran and the US has [USN:L6N45K0UX TEXT:"put pressure"] on the country's economy.
Mehdi Tabatabaei, communications deputy in the president's office, told state TV that Paknejad resigned for personal reasons "a long time ago" and his resignation was accepted by President Masoud Pezeshkian at Paknejad's insistence.
"With acceptance of Mohsen Paknejad's resignation by Dr. Pezeshkian, Hamid Bovard has been appointed as acting oil minister", Tabatabaei said earlier on Sunday, according to state media.
Before news of his resignation, Paknejad was quoted by state media as saying "revenues of the oil that we have sold are still coming and that will continue God willing".

items.title: Valentino unveils corset tops and chunky jewellery at fashion show in 19th-century Paris library

items.summary: Valentino showed colourful corset tops, lace skirts and chunky gold necklaces on Sunday in a fashion show creative director Alessandro Michele dubbed "Antibiblioteca", set in the iconic reading room of the 19th-century Bibliothèque Sainte-Geneviève in Paris.
items.body:
Valentino showed colourful corset tops, lace skirts and chunky gold necklaces on Sunday in a fashion show creative director Alessandro Michele dubbed "Antibiblioteca", set in the iconic reading room of the 19th-century Bibliothèque Sainte-Geneviève in Paris.
On a sun-drenched afternoon, celebrities arrived each clutching a book which they showed off to the cameras and a large crowd of assembled fans. Guests including actors Alexander Skarsgard and Cynthia Erivo, American stylist Law Roach, and Chinese model Yidan Huang took their seats at long oak reading tables dotted with green lamps, under the library's iron latticework ceiling arches.
Michele has led the Roman [USN:L8N3YK19Q TEXT:"fashion house"] since March 2024 and is under pressure to revive sales at the brand that swung to a €103 million [USN:S8N40Y041 TEXT:"loss"] last year as revenues fell 15%. He was previously creative director at Gucci for eight years where his maximalist aesthetic and gender-fluid, eccentric designs like fur-lined loafers [USN:L8N32K398 TEXT:"reinvigorated"] the brand and boosted sales.
Models prowled along the library stacks in tight silk corset tops in bright blue, yellow, or hot pink, paired with skirts in contrasting colours. Dresses were strapless too, with the final look a floor-length Valentino red number with a giant black bow. Lace skirts and shirts had ostrich-feather hems.
Jewellery was chunky and colourful, with elaborate, baroque gold necklaces and giant pearl earrings. Women and men wore cross-body handbags or held rectangular clutches with studs and sequins.
Men wore half-buttoned double-breasted jackets or sequinned shirts, sporting tinted sunglasses and bright baseball caps with "VILLAIN TEEN" printed on them.
In June Valentino's shareholders — Qatar-backed Mayhoola, which owns 70% of the company, and French luxury group Kering, which holds the remaining 30% — committed additional financial support for 2026 after debt increased. Kering has options to increase its ownership to 100% before 2029.

items.title: Jonathan Taylor, Colts rush past injury-riddled Commanders
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Jonathan Taylor ran for two touchdowns and the Indianapolis Colts pulled away in the fourth quarter to record a 30-13 victory over the undermanned Washington Commanders on Sunday in London.
items.body:
Jonathan Taylor ran for two touchdowns and the Indianapolis Colts pulled away in the fourth quarter to record a 30-13 victory over the undermanned Washington Commanders on Sunday in London.
Taylor scored on a pair of 5-yard runs, enabling Indianapolis (2-2) to overcome a quick 6-0 deficit. He finished with 95 yards on 20 carries as the Colts made the most of their 257 yards.
Quarterback Daniel Jones shrugged off a pair of early turnovers to complete 19 of 34 passes for 143 yards and an interception. He also added the clinching score by running 5 yards on 3rd-and-2 for a touchdown with 11:38 left in the game that made it a two-touchdown margin.
Washington (1-3) played most of the day with rookie Athan Kaliakmanis at quarterback after starter Marcus Mariota suffered a right knee injury in the first quarter and wasn't able to return.
Kaliakmanis completed 15 of 33 passes for 186 yards with a touchdown and an interception. Mariota connected on 3 of 4 passes for 46 yards and rushed for 35 yards on one carry before departing.
The Commanders got off to a quick start, getting a strip-sack on Indianapolis' second play and converting that into Drew Stevens' 31-yard field goal just 2:03 into the game. Stevens made it 6-0 on a 29-yard field goal from Stevens with 6:21 left in the quarter.
That lead held until the Colts, who managed only 33 yards on their first four possessions, finally found traction. Taylor's first touchdown run with 3:23 remaining in the half put them ahead for good and Spencer Shrader's 48-yard field goal made it 10-6 at the break.
Taylor scored again at the 12:45 mark of the third quarter, four plays after Kaliakmanis tossed an interception. But Kaliakmanis responded with a 47-yard touchdown pass to Traylon Burks with 10:39 left in the period.
Shrader drilled a 52-yarder with 7:03 remaining in the third for a 20-13 advantage. In the fourth quarter, he added a 44-yarder with 5:48 on the clock to cap the scoring.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Vídeo de porta-aviões dos EUA no Rio de Janeiro não foi feito em meio às eleições
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Imagens de um porta-aviões dos Estados Unidos no Rio de Janeiro não foram feitas no contexto das eleições brasileiras deste domingo, como afirmam publicações nas redes sociais. A gravação circula ao menos desde maio deste ano.
items.body:
Imagens de um porta-aviões dos Estados Unidos no Rio de Janeiro não foram feitas no contexto das eleições brasileiras deste domingo, como afirmam publicações nas redes sociais. A gravação circula ao menos desde maio deste ano.
Estes são os principais detalhes:
“Porta-avião americano chega ao Rio de Janeiro”, dizem postagens com o registro no Instagram. “Bora tudo de novo… Somente em caso de guerra ou conflito instalado as embaixadas fecham”, descreve a legenda de uma delas.
Na última sexta-feira, a embaixada dos EUA no Brasil anunciou a suspensão dos serviços consulares no país citando preocupações com segurança.
A medida ocorreu em meio ao temor de autoridades brasileiras de que o governo do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, tente interferir nas eleições.
O vídeo checado, no entanto, não tem relação com esses fatos -- um perfil no Instagram compartilhou as mesmas imagens em 10 de maio deste ano.
No registro, um homem mostra a embarcação e diz: “O porta-avião que acabou de chegar, americano, aqui na Baía de Guanabara”. Ele filma a ponte Rio-Niterói e o nome do navio, Nimitz .
O porta-aviões USS Nimitz esteve na capital fluminense em maio para um exercício conjunto, segundo a embaixada dos EUA no Brasil e as forças militares dos dois países. Segundo a Marinha brasileira, a embarcação deixou a cidade ainda naquele mês .
Desde então, não há registros de que o navio tenha voltado ao Brasil.
Veredicto: Legenda errada. O vídeo de um porta-aviões dos EUA no Rio de Janeiro é de maio e não está relacionado às eleições brasileiras.
Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

items.title: UAE fans snap up Jeddah flights within minutes ahead of Gulf Cup Final
items.author: Ashraf Hamid
items.creator: Ashraf Hamid
items.summary: UAE supporters have provided an early taste of Gulf Cup final fever, snapping up seats on six charter flights to Jeddah in less than 10 minutes as excitement builds for Tuesday's title clash against Saudi Arabia.
items.body:
UAE supporters have provided an early taste of Gulf Cup final fever, snapping up seats on six charter flights to Jeddah in less than 10 minutes as excitement builds for Tuesday's title clash against Saudi Arabia.
The rush began shortly after the UAE Football Association opened registration for fans wishing to travel to the Gulf Cup final, turning what was meant to be a routine booking process into a frantic race for seats.
The association had arranged six aircraft to transport supporters to Saudi Arabia after the national team's qualification for the final, hoping to ensure a strong Emirati presence in the stands. Local media reported that all available seats were taken within minutes of registration opening at 1 p.m. UAE time.
The surge in demand came a day after the UAE defeated Oman 1-0 in Jeddah to reach its first Gulf Cup final since 2018, reigniting hopes of ending a 13-year wait for regional glory.
The UAE will face Saudi Arabia, who beat Asian champions Qatar in a penalty shootout, in Jeddah on Tuesday as they seek to win the Gulf Cup title for a third time following their triumphs in 2007 and 2013. Saudi Arabia, meanwhile, are bidding to end a nearly 22-year wait for a Gulf Cup title.
With every seat claimed almost as soon as it became available, the rapid sellout offered an early indication of the atmosphere expected at King Abdullah Sports City on Tuesday, where a sizeable contingent of Emirati supporters is expected.

items.title: Musk says he will rename SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Donald Trump has been pushing the term "super intelligence" instead of "artificial intelligence."
items.body:
SpaceX CEO Elon Musk posted on Sunday that he would rename the company's AI unit to SpaceXSI, following US President Donald Trump's [USN:L6N45E0R5 TEXT:"push"] to use the term "super intelligence" instead of "artificial intelligence."
"Yes, we will make that change," he replied to a user on X asking him about the possibility of renaming SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI.
Here are a few more details:
At the time of publication, SpaceXAI's X account had not been changed.
Musk did not provide any additional information regarding the name change, nor did he give a potential timeline for when the change would occur.
SpaceXAI did not immediately respond to a request for comment regarding the change.
In a speech last month to the UN General Assembly, Trump said: "From this point forward, all of United States documents, and hopefully the world's will be changed to use the much more accurate term 'super' as opposed to artificial. So it's super intelligence."
items.raw_description: Donald Trump has been pushing the term "super intelligence" instead of "artificial intelligence."

items.title: How the fashionable Indian was spoilt for choice after 1991 reforms
items.author: Veenu Sandhu, Sneha Dasghosh
items.summary: Liberalisation brought a flood of international brands into India, but failed to help create a global brand from within the country ...
items.body: India’s affair with the fashion industry started in the colonial era, with the first fashion show, with European clothes and models, held in the 1930s. Post-Independence, after a lull of about a decade, the shows returned in the 1950s with the Spencer sisters — Sylla and Nergish — who brought in the concept of designerwear, choreography and catwalks. That would set the stage for what was to come after India opened itself to the world in 1991.

items.title: Suprema Corte dos EUA avalia pedido de petroleiras contra ação relacionada a clima
items.author: John Kruzel, Andrew Chung
items.creator: John Kruzel, Andrew Chung
items.summary: A Suprema Corte dos EUA inicia seu novo mandato de nove meses nesta segunda-feira com as audiências de um importante caso envolvendo uma tentativa das empresas petrolíferas ExxonMobil e Suncor Energy de impedir uma ação movida por autoridades de Boulder, no Colorado, que buscam indenização por danos causados pelas mudanças climáticas.
items.body:
A Suprema Corte dos EUA inicia seu novo mandato de nove meses nesta segunda-feira com as audiências de um importante caso envolvendo uma tentativa das empresas petrolíferas ExxonMobil (XOM.N) e Suncor Energy (SU.TO) de impedir uma ação movida por autoridades de Boulder, no Colorado, que buscam indenização por danos causados pelas mudanças climáticas.
Este é o primeiro de vários casos importantes já agendados para o período, com disputas envolvendo questões como as políticas de imigração do presidente Donald Trump e as proibições estaduais de fuzis de assalto a serem julgadas nos próximos meses. A maioria conservadora de 6 a 3 da Corte levou a Justiça dos EUA a uma guinada drástica para a direita nos últimos anos.
O órgão judicial máximo dos EUA, como é de costume, inicia seu mandato na primeira segunda-feira de outubro.
A Exxon, com sede nos EUA, e a Suncor, com sede no Canadá, entraram com recurso depois que a Suprema Corte do Colorado autorizou a continuação da ação movida pela cidade de Boulder, que as acusa de violações da legislação estadual. O governo Trump apoiou a Exxon e a Suncor, argumentando que a legislação federal impede as reivindicações de Boulder.
Os governos municipal e do condado de Boulder acusaram as duas empresas de contribuir para as mudanças climáticas e de enganar o público sobre os riscos dos combustíveis fósseis. Boulder pretende responsabilizar as empresas pelos custos passados e futuros associados às mudanças climáticas, como reparos na infraestrutura, danos ambientais, gestão de emergências e prejuízos à saúde pública.
A queima de combustíveis fósseis libera gases de efeito estufa, incluindo dióxido de carbono, na atmosfera, retendo calor e elevando as temperaturas médias globais ao longo do tempo.
Quase 60 governos estaduais e locais entraram com ações semelhantes buscando bilhões de dólares das empresas de combustíveis fósseis, e mais ações continuam sendo apresentadas, informaram a Exxon e a Suncor aos juízes. Uma decisão da Suprema Corte a favor das empresas poderia levar à rejeição de muitos desses processos.
Os argumentos apresentados na segunda-feira marcam o mais recente exemplo de empresas do setor de energia solicitando aos juízes que bloqueiem a responsabilidade relacionada ao clima ou limitem a regulamentação ambiental federal.
Os defensores das empresas petrolíferas argumentam que, se as alegações de maior alcance de Boulder forem autorizadas a prosseguir, isso poderia conferir aos Estados amplos poderes sobre condutas que ocorrem muito além de suas fronteiras.
Empresas do setor de energia e associações comerciais, juntamente com os Estados aliados a elas, têm construído um histórico de vitórias diante dos juízes nas últimas duas décadas em casos envolvendo responsabilidade climática e o alcance da regulamentação ambiental federal.
A Exxon e a Suncor argumentam, entre outras coisas, que as alegações de Boulder se intrometem em uma área regida pela Lei do Ar Limpo.
O juiz Samuel Alito se recusou a participar do caso. Alito possui ações em várias empresas de petróleo e gás, mas não na Exxon nem na Suncor, de acordo com seus formulários de declaração de bens.
A decisão da Suprema Corte está prevista para o final de junho.

items.title: Ukrainian drones deliver new batch of food to Russian-occupied Oleshky
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ukraine's military has again used drones to deliver food and medicines to the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky in southern Ukraine, Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said on Sunday.
items.body:
Ukraine's military has again used drones to deliver food and medicines to the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky in southern Ukraine, Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said on Sunday.
Oleshky, a frontline town on the Dnipro River, which separates Russian and Ukrainian forces, has been under Russian occupation since 2022.
"For months, Russia has been trying to isolate Ukrainians in Oleshky from the outside world, even obstructing the delivery of food to people facing severe shortages," Sybiha said on X.
Ukraine used heavy-lift drones to deliver [USN:L8N45K0TH TEXT:"food and medicines"] to Oleshky at the end of September.
Sybiha said that the latest delivery consisted of nearly 400 packages containing almost 4 metric tons of food and medicine.
Ukrainian human rights ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets told Ukrainian media last month that Russia had not agreed to Ukrainian proposals to allow civilians to evacuate from Oleshky.
The Kremlin said that Oleshky [USN:R4N45100U TEXT:"had critical problems"] with food and medicine supplies, but that Russia's military was working to resolve them.
items.raw_description: Ukraine's military has again used drones to deliver food and medicines to the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky in southern Ukraine, Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said on Sunday.

items.title: Policía española desaloja un campamento de migrantes en la playa de Ceuta antes de la visita real
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La policía española desalojó el domingo un campamento de migrantes situado en una playa del enclave norteafricano de Ceuta, donde decenas de miles de personas cruzaron la frontera desde Marruecos hace más de dos meses, informó el Gobierno español.
items.body:
La policía española desalojó el domingo un campamento de migrantes situado en una playa del enclave norteafricano de Ceuta, donde decenas de miles de personas cruzaron la frontera desde Marruecos hace más de dos meses, informó el Gobierno español.
Más de 72.000 personas cruzaron la frontera desde Marruecos hacia Ceuta a finales de julio. Aunque la mayoría de los migrantes regresaron posteriormente, al menos 10.000 permanecen en el enclave español del norte de África, lo que supone una carga para los recursos locales y aviva la tensión.
La policía trasladó a los migrantes desde la playa de Trampolín, donde unas 3.000 personas llevaban dos meses viviendo en tiendas de campaña y refugios improvisados, a alojamientos temporales donde se tramitarán sus expedientes o podrán regresar a Marruecos, dijo el domingo a Reuters un portavoz del Ministerio del Interior español.
La tensión han persistido por la presencia de migrantes que duermen a la intemperie en el pequeño enclave, donde viven unas 80.000 personas. Los vecinos organizaron el sábado una manifestación para pedir que los migrantes se marcharan.
El rey Felipe y la reina Letizia tienen previsto visitar Ceuta del 13 al 14 de octubre por primera vez en los doce años de reinado del monarca. La visita se conoce en medio de la tensión de larga data con Marruecos, que reclama la soberanía tanto sobre Ceuta como sobre el otro enclave español en el norte de África, Melilla.

items.body: The outcome of this week’s meeting of the six-member Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) will be closely followed. Aside from the decision on the policy rate, the meeting will also mark the completion of 10 years of the MPC. The first MPC meeting was held on October 3 and 4, 2016. A poll conducted by this newspaper last week showed that most economists expected the rate-setting panel to increase the policy repo rate by 25 basis points. There are compelling reasons for the central bank to adjust the policy rate. The consumer price index-based inflation rate increased to 4.8 per cent in August, as against 4.5 per cent in the previous month, and is expected to increase further.  The MPC’s own projections from the last meeting show that the rate is expected to increase to 5.9 per cent in the third quarter this financial year, and would remain above 5 per cent at least until the first quarter next financial year.

items.title: Former NHL defenseman, captain Lyle Odelein dies at 58
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Lyle Odelein, the inaugural captain of the Columbus Blue Jackets and a former Stanley Cup champion with the Montreal Canadiens, died at the age of 58.
items.body:
Lyle Odelein, the inaugural captain of the Columbus Blue Jackets and a former Stanley Cup champion with the Montreal Canadiens, died at the age of 58.
The Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reported that Odelein died of a heart attack on Friday.
The Blue Jackets honored Odelein on Saturday night with a video presentation and moment of silence. The former NHL defenseman served as their captain during the 2000-01 season after being claimed in the expansion draft from the then-Phoenix Coyotes.
"On the ice, Lyle was a fierce competitor and Stanley Cup champion," the Blue Jackets wrote in a statement. "Off the ice, he was warm, kind and quick with a smile and kind word."
Odelein played for eight different teams during his 16-year NHL career before announcing his retirement after the 2005-06 season.
He was selected by the Canadiens in the seventh round of the 1986 NHL Draft and helped Montreal capture the Stanley Cup in 1992-93. He totaled 252 points (50 goals, 202 assists) and 2,316 penalty minutes in 1,056 career games with the Canadiens, New Jersey Devils, Coyotes, Blue Jackets, Chicago Blackhawks, Dallas Stars, Florida Panthers and Pittsburgh Penguins.
--Field Level Media

items.title: PF abriu apuração sobre suposta interferência externa nas eleições do Brasil, diz diretor-geral
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O diretor-geral da Polícia Federal, Andrei Rodrigues, afirmou neste domingo que a corporação já abriu investigação para apurar suposto esquema de financiamento de uma agenda de extrema-direita no Brasil pelo governo norte-americano de Donald Trump que teria entre os objetivos interferir nas eleições brasileiras.
items.body:
O diretor-geral da Polícia Federal, Andrei Rodrigues, afirmou neste domingo que a corporação já abriu investigação para apurar suposto esquema de financiamento de uma agenda de extrema-direita no Brasil pelo governo norte-americano de Donald Trump que teria entre os objetivos interferir nas eleições brasileiras.
A investigação foi [USN:L1N45N119 TEXT:"solicitada"] pela Advocacia-Geral da União (AGU) na quinta-feira. Segundo Rodrigues, a área técnica da PF designou a Diretoria de Inteligência da corporação para tocar a apuração.
"Já é uma investigação em andamento, um procedimento prévio, mas ainda não foi publicada a portaria do inquérito policial", disse ele, ao ressaltar que é comum se abrir uma investigação preliminar antes do inquérito propriamente dito.
O pedido da AGU teve como base reportagem publicada no jornal inglês The Guardian, segundo a qual o Departamento de Estado norte-americano teria destinado US$1 milhão de um fundo ligado aos direitos humanos e à democracia para um programa chamado "Combate ao Lawfare e à Censura no Brasil".
EMBAIXADA Rodrigues disse também que investigações da PF até o momento não identificaram quaisquer riscos de ataques a embaixadas dos EUA e outras representações diplomáticas.
Na sexta-feira, a PF informou que [USN:L6N45O0XD TEXT:"cumpriu"] dois mandados de busca e apreensão em São Paulo e no entorno do Distrito Federal para apurar suposto planejamento de atos que poderiam colocar em risco instalações diplomáticas dos EUA no Brasil.
"Recebemos uma comunicação da embaixada dos Estados Unidos e, como é nosso dever, atuamos para apurar se tem alguma veracidade naqueles dados que nos foram encaminhados", disse Rodrigues neste domingo.
"Cumprimos as medidas judiciais, há um processo sigiloso e, de fato, não comprovamos nenhum elemento concreto que nos apontasse um risco efetivo para essa embaixada ou para qualquer outra embaixada", disse ele, em linha com comunicado da PF de sexta.
Representações diplomáticas dos EUA e da Austrália reduziram suas atividades na sexta.

items.title: Brasil vive las elecciones más grandes en su historia y elige entre Lula y Bolsonaro
items.author: Redacción Bloomberg Línea
items.summary: Los candidatos Lula, del Partido de los Trabajadores (PT), y Bolsonaro, del Partido Liberal (PL), acudieron a votar a primera hora de la mañana de este domingo 4 de octubre.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — Las elecciones de 2026 reúnen al mayor número de votantes en la historia de Brasil. Alrededor de 158,7 millones de votantes están habilitados para votar en las elecciones de este domingo 4 de octubre, según datos del Poder Electoral. Las elecciones determinarán la composición del Poder Ejecutivo federal y estatal y renovarán parte del Poder Legislativo para los próximos años. Los brasileños acuden a las urnas este domingo en una reñida primera vuelta electoral entre un presidente en ejercicio, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, del Partido de los Trabajoadores (PT), quien busca un cuarto mandato, y Flávio Bolsonaro, del Partido Liberal (PL), el hijo mayor del expresidente Jair Bolsonaro. Si hay una segunda vuelta para elegir al presidente y a los gobernadores, será el 25 de octubre. Ver más: Elecciones en Brasil: qué se juega el real, los bonos y las acciones entre Lula y Bolsonaro Del total de votantes habilitados, 141,3 millones ya tienen sus datos biométricos registrados, lo que equivale al 89% del electorado, según el Poder Electoral. Según el Tribunal Superior Electoral, hay 605.800 votantes de 16 años y poco más de un millón de votantes de 17 años -grupos de edad para los cuales el voto es facultativo. La contienda también se caracteriza por el gran número de candidatos. El Poder Electoral registra cerca de 21.000 solicitudes de candidatura. Más de la mitad se concentra en las elecciones para las asambleas legislativas y para la Cámara Legislativa del Distrito Federal. Hay cerca de 11.300 candidatos a diputado estatal y 433 a diputado distrital, lo que suma un total de cerca de 11.700 candidatos para estos cargos. Para la Cámara de Diputados, se registraron 7.803 candidatos. Ver más: Lula y Flávio Bolsonaro ponen a Caixa en el centro de sus planes para aliviar la deuda en Brasil La jornada electoral en Brasil comenzó a las 8:00 de la mañana, hora local, y recibirán a los votantes hasta las 17:00 horas. El votante hará seis selecciones en la urna, en este orden: Flávio Bolsonaro voto en Río de Janeiro. El senador llegó al centro de votación donde votó a primera hora de la mañana de este domingo en Río de Janeiro. Al candidato a la presidencia por el PL, lo acompañaban su esposa, Fernanda, y sus aliados. Según información del portal UOL, después de votar, abogó por el “voto útil”. Al hablar con la prensa, pidió a los votantes que están en contra del presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva que voten por él para que la elección se decida en la primera vuelta. El candidato y presidente en funcions, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, votó en un centro de votación de São Bernardo do Campo, en São Paulo. Lula estuvo acompañado por el vicepresidente Geraldo Alckmin, las candidatas al Senado Simone Tebet y Marina Silva, y el candidato a gobernador de São Paulo, Fernando Haddad. Tras votar, Lula se mostró confiado y criticó a su principal oponente, el senador Flávio Bolsonaro. “Lo que está en juego es definir un proyecto para Brasil. El pueblo tendrá que elegir entre el fortalecimiento del régimen democrático o la barbarie, entre el desarrollo y el atraso (...) Brasil no avanzará con milicianos, con la orgía en torno a la banda del banco Master. Brasil avanza con seriedad”, dijo, según el portal UOL. Con información de la Agencia Brasil.

items.title: Irán dice que el estrecho de Ormuz no se reabrirá hasta que se cumplan las condiciones
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El estrecho de Ormuz no se reabrirá hasta que se cumplan las siete condiciones iraníes establecidas en un acuerdo provisional firmado en junio con Estados Unidos, informaron el domingo los medios estatales, citando al presidente del Parlamento iraní, Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf.
items.body:
El estrecho de Ormuz no se reabrirá hasta que se cumplan las siete condiciones iraníes establecidas en un acuerdo provisional firmado en junio con Estados Unidos, informaron el domingo los medios estatales, citando al presidente del Parlamento iraní, Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf.
Irán presentó una propuesta durante la Asamblea General de la ONU según la cual la vía navegable del estrecho de Ormuz podría reabrirse y restablecerse el paso marítimo normal en un plazo de siete días si se cumplían las condiciones, a lo que Estados Unidos respondió la semana pasada a través de intermediarios qataríes.
"La postura de la República Islámica de Irán es totalmente clara y firme, y el estrecho de Ormuz no se abrirá hasta que se cumplan nuestras siete condiciones, basadas en el Memorándum de Entendimiento de Islamabad", dijo Qalibaf, principal negociador de Irán, según fue citado.
Afirmó que Washington "debe comprender que se ha acabado el tiempo de alargar el proceso (diplomático) y de imponer exigencias unilaterales".
IRÁN DICE NO HAY CONVERSACIONES NUCLEARES Un portavoz del Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores dijo el domingo que Teherán había aclarado sus posiciones generales, a través de los mediadores, en respuesta a la postura estadounidense, pero que aún quedaban algunos puntos adicionales por comunicar a Washington.
"Las propuestas de los estadounidenses están más o menos en línea con sus posiciones anteriores, concretamente en lo que respecta a la cuestión nuclear. Les hemos dicho que nuestro enfoque en esta fase es la cuestión del estrecho de Ormuz y que el restablecimiento de la seguridad en esta vía navegable requiere medidas claras por parte de Estados Unidos", dijo el portavoz Esmaeil Baghaei.
Asimismo, negó que Teherán hubiera ofrecido a la agencia de control nuclear de la ONU inspecciones de sus instalaciones nucleares a cambio del levantamiento de las sanciones estadounidenses, y señaló que Irán no había entablado conversaciones nucleares con Washington.
El documento que se está distribuyendo esboza un período de siete días destinado a fomentar la confianza, con el objetivo de que ambas partes retomen una versión mejorada del memorándum de entendimiento acordado en junio, que incluye medidas concretas sobre el programa nuclear de Irán, dijo la semana pasada un funcionario informado sobre las conversaciones.
El desacuerdo se centra en la secuencia de las medidas, más que en los componentes del plan, añadió el funcionario.
Qatar ha estado transmitiendo mensajes entre Washington y Teherán en un intento por poner fin al conflicto y reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz, por donde circulaba una quinta parte del petróleo y el gas natural licuado del mundo antes de la guerra que comenzó a finales de febrero con los ataques de Estados Unidos e Israel contra Irán.
El memorándum de entendimiento de junio dio lugar a un breve alto el fuego e incluía disposiciones sobre el estrecho y el programa nuclear de Irán.
Por otra parte, el ministro de Asuntos Exteriores, Abás Araqchi, dijo el domingo ante embajadores y diplomáticos extranjeros en Teherán que Irán esperaba que Washington optara por la vía diplomática, pero advirtió que su país estaba preparado para responder si Estaos Unidos volvía a optar por la acción militar.
El jueves, algunas fuentes informaron a Reuters de que Irán estaba preparando una respuesta más amplia y contundente en caso de que Washington reanudara los ataques militares a gran escala.
"Si vuelven a optar por soluciones militares, estamos más preparados que antes y tomaremos todas las medidas necesarias para defendernos", dijo Araqchi el domingo.
El portavoz del Ejército, Mohammad Akraminia, dijo el domingo a la agencia de noticias Fars que Irán aumentaría el alcance de sus misiles.

items.title: Ukraine believes Russia shared jet-drone technology with North Korea, says Zelenskiy
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Sunday he believed Russia may have shared jet-drone technology with its longstanding ally North Korea.
items.body:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Sunday he believed Russia may have shared jet-drone technology with its longstanding ally North Korea.
In recent weeks, Russia has sharply increased its use of jet-drones against Ukraine, which so far has no effective means of countering them other than using combat aircraft.
Earlier in the war, North Korea supplied Russia with millions of artillery shells, and it has since provided ballistic missiles that Moscow regularly uses to attack Ukrainian cities.
Asked if Russia had shared with North Korea the technology behind its latest generation of jet-powered drones, Zelenskiy told journalists: "Yes, of course."
"They (Russia) are sharing with North Korea all the technologies. I don't know about the ballistic and etc, but I think, yes, because North Korea helped them with missiles," he added.
South Korea and Western countries have previously voiced concerns that Pyongyang may be [USN:L1N44F07G TEXT:"getting help with weapons development"] from Moscow in return for its help in Ukraine.
Thousands of North Korean soldiers were sent to Russia to gain combat experience in the war.
Seoul and Kyiv have been locked in a diplomatic dispute since Zelenskiy announced at the United Nations General Assembly last month that Ukraine had transferred two North Korean prisoners of war captured while fighting for Russia to South Korea.
South Korean President Lee Jae Myung on Friday [USN:L1N45O011 TEXT:"threatened"] unspecified measures against Ukraine unless Kyiv acknowledged a confidentiality agreement that Seoul says covered the transfer and issued an apology.
"South Korea asked us to give them North Korean soldiers. By the way, according to their constitution, they are their citizens ... so we gave them these two guys," Zelenskiy said, without alluding to Lee's comments.

items.title: France/Lycées Entre 400 et 500 établissements encore fermés lundi - ministre
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Entre 400 et 500 lycées devraient rester complètement ou partiellement fermés lundi en France, sur un total de 3.700, soit des chiffres similaires à vendredi, a déclaré dimanche le ministre de l'Education Edouard Geffray, signe que la mobilisation des lycéens ne faiblit pas.
items.body:
Entre 400 et 500 lycées devraient rester complètement ou partiellement fermés lundi en France, sur un total de 3.700, soit des chiffres similaires à vendredi, a déclaré dimanche le ministre de l'Education Edouard Geffray, signe que la mobilisation des lycéens ne faiblit pas.
"Il y avait entre 400 et 500 lycées qui ont suspendu leurs cours vendredi et il y en aura probablement autant lundi mais avec une reprise partielle et progressive des cours qui va se mettre en place", a-t-il précisé sur France 2.
Edouard Geffray a tenté de calmer vendredi la mobilisation dans les lycées en France en recevant les représentants de syndicats étudiants, qui ont fait part de leur déception et appelé à [USN:L8N45O1H4 TEXT:"poursuivre leur mouvement"].
Tout en se désolidarisant des violences ayant éclaté en marge des blocages d'établissements, ils ont appelé à des rassemblements mardi 6 octobre et seront rejoints par plusieurs confédérations syndicales dont la CGT.
Les élèves qui bloquent les lycées dénoncent notamment des classes surpeuplées, le manque d'enseignants ou encore la vétusté des bâtiments, attribuant ces problèmes à des années de sous-investissement dans le secteur de l'enseignement public.
Dans une lettre adressée à Edouard Geffray ainsi qu'à d'autres ministres, le Premier ministre Sébastien Lecornu demande à ce que "cinq chantiers" soient engagés "pour répondre aux difficultés des lycéens et des personnels".
Parmi les chantiers énumérés, celui que Sébastien Lecornu considère comme le plus important est la nécessité de donner des "suites visibles à la parole de lycéens".
"Chaque proposition recevra une réponse motivée, avec une échéance lorsqu'elle sera retenue", a déclaré le Premier ministre, demandant à ses ministres des "premières décisions, leur coût, leur financement et leur calendrier" d'ici la fin du mois.
ACCÉLÉRER L'EXAMEN DU PROJET DE LOI "CASSEUR-PAYEUR" "La confiance se rétablira lorsque chacun pourra constater ce qui change dans son lycée", a encore dit Sébastien Lecornu, qui adopte aussi un ton de fermeté par rapport aux violences qui ont émaillé les blocages.
"Avec le ministre de l'Intérieur et le garde des Sceaux, nous allons accélérer l'examen du projet de loi "casseur-payeur", pour mieux faire supporter aux auteurs de dégradations le coût des dommages causés", a-t-il ajouté.
"La fermeté face aux violences et aux tentatives d'instrumentalisation doit aller de pair avec l'écoute des inquiétudes légitimes. Notre soutien va aux élèves et personnels agressés, aux policiers et gendarmes blessés."
Edouard Geffray a précisé dimanche que 24 établissements scolaires avaient été "incendiés ou saccagés" et que "78 personnels" de l'éducation nationale avaient été blessés depuis le début du mouvement.
Depuis lundi, environ 5.000 personnes, pour la plupart des adolescents, ont été interpellées dans tout le pays et des dizaines d'autres ont été blessées.
Le mobilisation lycéenne est partie le 18 septembre d'établissements en banlieue parisienne [USN:L6N45P01N TEXT:"défavorisés"] avant de s'étendre au reste du pays.
